Name: Eve
Role: First Woman; Mother of All Living
Summary: Eve was the first woman, created by God as Adam's companion and helper. Scripture calls her the mother of all the living.
KeyStory: Deceived by the serpent, Eve ate the forbidden fruit and gave it to Adam, yet she also received the first promise of a Redeemer to come.
LifeLesson: God did not abandon Eve after her failure; He clothed her in grace and spoke hope over her future. Your mistakes are not the end of your story either.
